comment: Sample lookup is off by one in src/controller/SampleController.cpp:23-31: index 0 and index 1 both return samples[0], and samples[numSamples-1] is never returned, so the last of the 14 samples cannot be selected from the panel. The maker names no port or knob, so every name here comes from the rendered panel. Each module declares 48 inputs and 16 outputs for up to 16 voices; only 2 are built, and the rest have no widget. src/controller/OpenHH.cpp:19 passes a CV range of 0 to 14 while the knob only reaches 13, so the CV input can push the total past the last sample, where sampleId returns the first one. The choke CV scaling in the manual (0.25 seconds per volt) disagrees with src/controller/OpenHH.cpp:39, which gives 0.049 seconds per volt.
